metadata.title: [DOCS]: OAuth audience handling, resource configuration, and troubleshooting
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

Documentation closing the last open acceptance criterion from issue #4384.  Stacked on #4476 (hybrid features); base must be ``feat/oauth-aud-resource-hybrid`` not ``main``.

## Changes

### Updated: ``docs/docs/architecture/oauth-design.md``

- **Removed** the "Known Gap: No local audience/scope pre-validation" admonition (no longer applies after #4404 + #4476).
- **Added** new "Audience handling and RFC 8707" section explaining:
  - The three-stage audience resolution: explicit config -> learned from IdP -> origin fallback
  - The authoritative-vs-advisory validation distinction
  - Implementation references with file:line links

### Created: ``docs/docs/manage/oauth-resource-configuration.md`` (new)

End-user guide covering:

- When you don't need to do anything (most cases auto-derive + auto-learn)
- When to set the field explicitly (multi-tenant Entra ID, multiple audiences, recovery)
- Provider patterns for Salesforce, Azure AD, Authentik, ServiceNow, Keycloak
- Multi-resource configurations (comma-separated UI input)
- How to force a re-learn after IdP migration (clear the field)
- Authoritative vs advisory validation behavior

Wired into ``docs/docs/manage/.pages``.

### Updated: ``docs/docs/manage/oauth-troubleshooting.md``

New "Token audience mismatch" section with:

- Symptom (the specific error message)
- Diagnosis steps (check oauth_config, decode JWT, check IdP RFC 8707 support)
- Common causes and fixes (Authentik/ServiceNow client_id, multi-tenant Entra ID, stale learned resource, Salesforce origin)
- Useful debug log targets
- Clarification of gateway/upstream MCP server validation responsibility split

## Stack

| | Branch | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | ``bugfix/oauth-aud-resource-narrow`` | #4475 — must merge first |
| 2 | ``feat/oauth-aud-resource-hybrid`` | #4476 — must merge second |
| **3** | ``docs/oauth-audience-handling`` | **this PR** |

## Acceptance criteria from #4384

This PR closes the remaining documentation criterion.  The full set is checked in #4476's description.

## Verification

- 496 affected unit tests still pass (no behavior changes)
- Mkdocs build was not run locally; rendering should be verified in CI

commits.message:
docs(oauth): document audience handling, resource configuration, and troubleshooting

Updates to fulfill issue #4384's documentation acceptance criteria:

- docs/docs/architecture/oauth-design.md: removed the 'Known Gap: No local
  audience/scope pre-validation' admonition and added a new 'Audience
  handling and RFC 8707' section explaining the three-stage audience
  resolution (explicit -> learned -> origin fallback) and the
  authoritative-vs-advisory validation distinction.

- docs/docs/manage/oauth-resource-configuration.md (new): end-user guide
  covering when to leave the field blank (most cases), when to set it
  explicitly, common provider patterns (Salesforce, Azure AD, Authentik,
  ServiceNow, Keycloak), multi-resource configurations, and how to force
  a re-learn after IdP migration.  Wired into docs/docs/manage/.pages.

- docs/docs/manage/oauth-troubleshooting.md: added 'Token audience
  mismatch' section with diagnosis steps, common causes/fixes, useful
  debug log targets, and clarification of the gateway/upstream MCP
  server validation responsibility split.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
